def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0]) if h else 0
    tokens={}
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(1,w-1):
            if row[c]==0 and row[c-1]!=0 and row[c-1]==row[c+1]:
                tokens.setdefault(c,[]).append((r,row[c-1]))
    for c,items in tokens.items():
        prev=-1
        for r,color in sorted(items):
            for rr in range(prev+1,r+1):
                out[rr][c]=color
            prev=r
        lower=[grid[rr][c] for rr in range(prev+1,h) if grid[rr][c]!=0]
        if lower:
            bottom_color=lower[0]
            for rr in range(prev+1,h):
                out[rr][c]=bottom_color
    return out

def parse(s):
    return [[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in s.strip().splitlines()]
